text: I have a Litecoin fork of libbitcoin that I’m working on and it’s 90% done. All tests pass and all 3 chains are configured and connect to their p2p networks. The only issue is `chain_state::work_required_retarget` seems to be off by just a little bit on every retarget after block 12096. Perhaps this commit is the reason why: <https://github.com/litecoin-project/litecoin/commit/1f553b07cf5f500215baac66f0145fabc6d9ce59>
